caption: The drawing depicts a single stone object resembling a baptismal font or large ornate pedestal. It has a circular basin at the top with a thick rim, featuring vertical, rounded, groove-like indentations around its outer surface. The basin is supported by a hexagonal or faceted plinth, which widens toward the base and has several stacked, stepped layers. The stone surface appears rough and aged, with uneven textures and areas of discoloration. The predominant color is a muted beige or light tan, with subtle variations suggesting shadows, wear, and weathering. The object is centered on a plain, off-white background with no other items or features visible. The name "Rose Campbell Clarke" is written in small text in the lower right corner.
title: Stone Baptismal Font
